verdict.rationale: Docs confirm the core flow: create a session server-side via POST /v1/sessions, bring the end-user to verification via hosted or embedded web/native SDKs, and read results via webhook or by polling the decision endpoint — covering document+selfie/liveness capture without building custom capture UI. missing for 10: no independent/hands-on developer corroboration of the end-to-end flow and no explicit confirmation that both document and selfie capture are bundled by default in the hosted flow.
